data.title: Facts in parallel: the job (+ its request), its I step rows, the I1 intent, its manifest, the Item Assembly's status and lock, op 1's engine rows
The job (+ DB clock, lease flag, lease_until, due; request: prevStatus, action)
data.nodeName: The job (+ DB clock, lease flag, lease_until, due; request: prevStatus, action)
data.name: The job (+ DB clock, lease flag, lease_until, due; request: prevStatus, action)

script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(n.t + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_until,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id, j.organization_id, j.command, j.job_status, j.progress_percent, j.progress_message, j.attempt_count,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at, j.lease_owner,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live, (j.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR j.next_attempt_at <= n.t) AS due,
       j.row_version, j.error_code, j.error_message, j.error_details, j.idempotency_key, j.correlation_id, j.is_deleted, j.line_count,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.request_payload, '$.prevStatus')), NULL) AS prev_status,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.request_payload, '$.action')), NULL) AS req_action
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IACguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_IACguard.data.jobId}}

script.code:
SELECT CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS ia_id, g.item_assembly_status, g.ia_v2_job_id AS ia_v2_job_id, g.stock_movement_no, g.item_id,
       (SELECT p.result_ref FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND p.job_id = CONCAT('IAC|', SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4)) AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_ref
  FROM gd_async_job j
  JOIN sm_item_assembly g ON g.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND g.id = CAST(SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4) AS UNSIGNED) AND g.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IACguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_IACguard.data.jobId}}
   AND j.correlation_id REGEXP '^IA\\|[0-9]{1,20}$'

script.code:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IACguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = 'IAC|{{node:code_node_IACguard.data.jobId}}|I' AND p.step_name LIKE 'IBA|I|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0) AS intents,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IACguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = 'IAC|{{node:code_node_IACguard.data.jobId}}|I' AND p.step_name = 'IBA|REVIEW' AND p.is_deleted = 0) AS review,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(p.result_ref, '$.summary') AS CHAR) FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IACguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = 'IAC|{{node:code_node_IACguard.data.jobId}}|I' AND p.step_name = 'IBA|DONE' AND p.is_deleted = 0
           AND JSON_VALID(p.result_ref)
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS done_summary

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IACguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = 'IAC|{{node:code_node_IACguard.data.jobId}}|I' AND p.step_name LIKE 'IBA|I|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0) AS intents,

script.code:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(m.total_price), 0) AS CHAR) AS total
  FROM inventory_movement m
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IACguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND m.id > {{node:code_node_IACguard.data.jobId}}
   AND m.is_deleted = 0
   AND m.movement = 'OUT'
   AND m.transaction_type = 'IA'
   AND m.trx_no = (SELECT h.stock_movement_no FROM sm_item_assembly h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IACguard.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IACentry.data.iaId}})
   AND m.operation_effect_key LIKE 'IAC|{{node:code_node_IACguard.data.jobId}}|I|%'

script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(h.id AS CHAR) AS ia_id, h.item_assembly_status, h.ia_v2_job_id AS ia_v2_job_id, h.stock_movement_no,
       (SELECT p.result_ref
          FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IACguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND p.job_id = 'IAC|{{node:code_node_IACentry.data.iaId}}'
           AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_ref,
       (SELECT p.step_name
          FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IACguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND p.job_id = 'IAC|{{node:code_node_IACentry.data.iaId}}'
           AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_step
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN sm_item_assembly h
    ON h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IACguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IACentry.data.iaId}}
   AND h.is_deleted = 0
